name: Touch FX Display Test
author: mrdjjag
summary: Display-only SDK prototype: channel memory, optional fader following; no audio effects.
description: Local display test. Adds a separate panel through SDK surfaces. No audio processing, extra sounds, Sweep/Crash boxes, native layout patches or firmware hooks. Vocals/Instrument indicators dim by default when the deck STEMS engine is off. Per-stem mute dimming is not implemented. Optional mixer follow requires all four crossfader assignments to be configured to match Utility settings. Does not replace azmod.so or azstem.so. Not the full v51 Touch FX implementation.
